key_difference: (D) checks completeness with `is_complete<T, void>` and no per-TU UniqueType, so the completeness-dependent `types()` can be folded inconsistently across TUs, which is the issue the reviewer raised; it also reintroduces Qt5-style PointerToQObject/IsGadget `QMetaTypeIdQObject` specializations that change `QMetaTypeId2::Defined` globally, where (B) only gates `ConnectionTypes` on a UniqueType-aware `TypeIsSuitableForMetaType` and calls `qMetaTypeId`.
